**What is the current behavior?**
seeing this error in minified version of code:

```
console error: Error: Minified React error #130; visit https://reactjs.org/docs/error-decoder.html?invariant=130&args[]=undefined&args[]= for the full message or use the non-minified dev environment for full errors and additional helpful warnings.
```

code works fine in:
- non-minified version
-  when compiled with 4.43.0 of webpack
